data.body: Completion-verifier result (2026-09-02): FAIL. The verifier pinned `035a50310268c767e6c3d7eca0d46e89a0b8f033` and could not see `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-29.md`, so the report-backed criteria are unmet in its codebase snapshot. Read-only diagnosis: the report is intentionally untracked by project policy. `git check-ignore -v` resolves it to the checkout-local `.git/info/exclude:26`; `git ls-files` confirms it is not versioned; and commit `c3baf99d32a4` explicitly removed janitor reports from the public mirror while preserving local agent tooling. `docs/documentation-policy.md` also excludes `.joe-janitor/**/*.md` from maintained-documentation scanning. The report exists locally and was updated with the plan-review close-out, but it is not durable repository evidence for the completion verifier. No force, AC retagging, or report-tracking change was made. The audit ticket remains in progress pending a maintainer decision on the intended durable/verifiable evidence boundary for local janitor reports.
